sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue_usd) AS revenue FROM finance.fct_revenue GROUP BY region
SELECT period, revenue_usd, cost_usd FROM finance.fct_revenue
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM finance.fct_revenue WHERE revenue_usd > 0 GROUP BY region
SELECT region, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM finance.fct_revenue GROUP BY region
